answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and mints a non-transferable cedar token to join the terrace roster. Each epoch the roster randomly pairs identities; each pair must exchange a live signal from both cedar tokens in 90 seconds, on the terrace; a missed or copied signal burns the bond. First fake: 42-credit fee; the k-th costs 42+8(k-1), each clone adding a pairing slot staffed live at once, so the 1000th costs 8034 and 1000 fakes cost 4,038,000 plus 60,000 locked. Rented operators fail: one staffs at most 6 windows at once, and signals cannot be precomputed. An honest agent pays 42 once.
